t: You're looking at a small brass stone set into the pavement in Soho. It's a Stolperstein, the first in the United Kingdom, and it commemorates Ada van Dantzig, a Holocaust victim who was born in 1918 and died in 1943. The stone was made by the German artist Gunter Demnig, whose project places engraved brass stones in front of the former homes of people persecuted and murdered by the Nazis. It began in Germany and has now spread to more than a hundred thousand stones across twenty-six countries in Europe.
